_rationale: Budgets are gzip bytes of JavaScript requested while loading a route (production build, fixtures, desktop Chromium), set from the measured value plus about 8 percent headroom, rounded up to the next 1000 B; the default for a route without an entry is the largest non-contact budget. Re-measured 10 Oct 2026 for ADR-024 (Motion for React islands: Reveal, menus, sheet, parallax), which added about 34.6 KB gzip to every route through the shared layout chunk: / 148821 -> 183459; the RichText/CmsImage templates 155164 -> 189802; /work /insights /labs 155764 -> 190402 (client-side filter island); /labs/:type 149643 -> 184281; 404 page 147591 -> 182229; /contact 189243 -> 223921 first-party (the enquiry form island) plus 27685 third-party (Cloudflare Turnstile api.js). The before and after table and the reasons are in docs/adr/ADR-024-motion.md. Third-party scripts are budgeted separately (maxThirdPartyJsGzipBytes, default 0) because their size changes without a deploy: only /contact may load one, with about 50 percent headroom. A budget is only raised in a PR that says why; the lab LCP and CLS values printed by the perf suite are advisory. Products (17 Oct 2026, PR #74): /products and /products/fauward measured 195658 first-party (the shared layout only, no island of their own); measured plus 8 percent would exceed the default ceiling, so both take the default 206000 (about 5 percent headroom). /products/sob-autofix (the product template's representative in tests/support/routes.ts since the SOB Autofix PR) is the same template with no island of its own and takes the same 206000.
